name: Bank Vault
desc1: This is a large iron room. The gate here is triply locked, with a
desc2: large steel door leading to the south. A sign in front of the door
desc3: reads "Silvermere Vault". Perhaps the untold fortunes of the city
desc4: elite can be found within. It would be impossible to say for any, but
desc5: the most skilled in skullduggery, would be unable to break in.
